messages:
incident-bot: Paging: detected elevated 5xx error rate for /v1/generate in prod-east starting 14:12 UTC. Current 503 spike at ~8%. Paging -> @alex (on-call). See auto-created incident: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1843219876

alex (on-call): I'm on it — collecting logs and tail traces now. Sanjay, can you confirm if autoscaler churn is happening?

Sanjay: looking — seeing queue growth + repeated container restarts on node-pool-rw-3. GPU mem pressure on a few pods, kernel-selection errors in logs. Pulling kernel traces.

Emily: prepping status page copy. Quick read/approve so we can post ASAP.

Emily: ```Status: Partial degradation in text generation (prod-east). Impact: increased 5xx responses and higher latency for a subset of dedicated customers. Mitigation: traffic partially rerouted and additional capacity brought online. ETA for full recovery: 30–45 minutes. Updates: every 15 minutes.```

Kate (CS): Draft customer-facing note below — want to keep it concise and action-oriented.

Kate (CS): ```Customer notice: We're investigating increased errors affecting text generation in US-East. Our engineers are actively mitigating by rerouting traffic and adding capacity. We will follow up with a timeline and any credits after root cause analysis. If you rely on Dedicated capacity in us-east, please reply here or open a support ticket and we'll prioritize.```

Jessica (Product): Which customers are affected? Is this just hosted or also Dedicated reservations?

alex (on-call): Affected: subset of Dedicated pools in prod-east and some hosted requests hitting the same runtime group. Tentative list: AcmeCorp, BrightApps, internal perf tests flagged. Kate — can CS confirm impacted accounts and preferred contact list?

Kate (CS): Confirmed for AcmeCorp and BrightApps. I'll send personalized messages after we confirm root cause and ETA. Also recommend offering 3 hours of credit for affected Dedicated capacity while we finalize RCA.

ops-bot: Mitigation actions applied: scaled fallback-routing to extra-quantized pool, increased replica count for pool-prod-east-3 by +2, disabled problematic kernel path on 2 nodes. Result: 503s dropped from 8% -> ~0.7% over 6 minutes.

Sanjay: Mitigation looks effective. Early hypothesis: autoscaler race condition + kernel selection edge-case under long-sequence workloads causing pod restarts. Opening follow-up issue: INF-4521. Will gather detailed logs and reproducer.

alex (on-call): Good. I'll post the status update now (Emily please paste final copy). Scheduling RCA touchpoint at 16:00 UTC. Owners: Sanjay (root cause & fix), Emily (status updates), Kate (customer comms + emails), Jessica (impact assessment + exec brief).

Emily: Posted status page update and pinned to incident channel. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1843219876/updates/1 :thumbsup:

Kate (CS): I'll queue personalized emails and support messages. Draft subject: "Service degradation affecting text generation — update from Redwood" — will send once we have final ETA and RCA notes.

Sanjay: After RCA we'll propose two preventatives: 1) autoscaler debounce to avoid thrash, 2) kernel-path fallback and extra mem headroom for long sequences. Will include measurable rollout plan in INF-4521.

Jessica (Product): Please capture affected SLOs and list of customers for exec summary. I'll prepare a short one-pager for EOD.

alex (on-call): Thanks all. Current plan: continue monitoring, keep status page updated every 15m until stable, RCA doc + customer follow-up template to be ready post-RCA. If error rate climbs again, re-open paging.

Kate (CS): Noted. I'll draft the customer follow-up (RCA summary + preventative actions + timeline) after the RCA meeting. Propose offering 3 hours Dedicated credit + 1:1 ops walkthrough for affected teams.

incident-bot: Incident state changed -> mitigated (partial). Next update scheduled in 15m.

alex (on-call): Closing routine updates here for now. Last check shows error rate steady at ~0.6%. Will hand off to Sanjay for deep dive. Thanks everyone :heart:
